notablePrerequisites: You control a token copy of Pestermite.
description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Pestermite token.
When the Pestermite token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Pestermite token.
Repeat.
